decisions.reason: A classic lever handle line close to the core range costs little to carry, and with industry turnover growing there is no shortfall against aspiration to trigger search for other uses of its resources.
This multi-model handle family supports the system breadth that architects specify, and the firm's slack lets it stay in the catalogue even though it was not visible on the website in 2020 and 2021.

A single design carries some risk of range rationalization after it dropped from website visibility, but there is no clear evidence it falls below aspiration, so keeping it remains the routine choice.
Like C, this is a low-cost design close to the core whose lack of website mentions makes it a candidate for pruning, yet performance near aspiration does not justify withdrawing it.
A lever handle family with several models fits the firm's strategy of broad system families, and stable growth in the industry keeps results near aspiration.

The flagship electronic access system anchors the move toward digital building organization, so strategic commitment and slack outweigh the risk that it is replaced by a newer generation as the technology changes quickly.
